text:
felix: Quick sync  we need a compact invite + clear acceptance gates for the next DP wave. Goal: 8 seats, conservative scope, 2-week run. Can we finalize today?

tara: I like simple gates: POC, 3 canonical prompts, opt-in to share redacted traces. Keep the invite copy short.

owen: +1. Suggest we also add a one-line 'what we won't do' list: no custom quant, no kernel work, no infra swaps. Saves negotiation.

maya: Also propose an outcomes section: what partners get (stipend + infra credits), and what we commit to (post-beta summary, one tuning session). Keeps ROI clear.

felix: Draft blurb idea: 
```
Join our 2-week Design Partner cohort (8 seats). Receive $400 + infra credits, a short onboarding call, and a post-beta performance summary. Requirements: single POC, run 3 test prompts, opt-in to share redacted traces. We cannot support custom quantization, kernel changes, or infra swaps during the beta.
```

tara: Add bullet: "Expected time commitment: <=3 hours". That reduces dropouts.

owen: For success metrics propose: 1) 6/8 partners complete feedback form, 2) median embedding sim >= 0.88 on canonical prompts, 3) 95th-pctl latency <= 300ms on dedicated test harness, 4) at least one actionable tuning item implemented.

maya: Nice. Also add a risk gate: if any partner reports a P0 regression vs their baseline, we pause rollouts for the cohort until triage. Keeps quality bar high.

legal-bot: Reminder: include a short data-sharing clause: partners consent to share redacted request/response samples and perf traces for debugging and product research. No full raw logs unless separately agreed.

felix: Good call. We should also include a short "how we measure" paragraph so partners know the low lift ask: run 3 prompts at start + end, fill a 6-question form, optional 30m interview.

tara: Can we offer opt-in observability access (read-only) for partners who want to monitor perf? Might be a nice perk.

own: Ops note: bulk invite quota is limited. ops-bot, what's our current limit?

ops-bot: Current outgoing invite cap = 420/hr. Suggest staggering sends across two hours to be safe. :robot_face:

felix: Action items: Tara -> finalize invite copy with time commitment line, Owen -> draft the "what we won't do" list & measurement paragraph, Maya -> confirm stipend/credit numbers and post-beta deliverables, Legal-bot -> provide final data-sharing sentence. I'll assemble and send tomorrow morning to #product-review.

maya: Quick ask: who will maintain the per-partner dashboard for latency/trace? Engineering ops volunteers?

own: I'll cover dashboard setup (small widgets: 95p latency, token counts, embed sim). Need partners to opt-in for traces.

felix: Thanks team. Keep copy tight and call out "no custom quant/kernels/infra" up front. We want fewer negotiation threads.

ops-bot: Note: schedule sends to avoid hitting quota. :calendar:

tara: I'll post the final copy by 11:30am.
